landing-primary.label: persistfmt aof-failure (1s, epoll)
landing-primary.cause: The added FLUSHALL check did not open the injected fail() diagnostic window within its unchanged four-second bound. The original scheduling twin can wait for a reply gate while holding a fused owner that FLUSH still needs.
landing-primary.evidence: SET opened the window and exited 1 without a reply. FLUSHALL reached the 168-byte increment limit, then failed its arming assertion; teardown escalated the owned scheduling twin. No successful FLUSH reply was observed. The other 39 persistfmt rows passed.
landing-primary.correction: Prepared trace markers and up to eight fresh-state attempts. Only a witnessed writer wait before any receipt gate may be retried; unexpected replies or other missing-window states fail. Every credited command still requires the actual blocked failure logger, no reply, and fatal exit 1. The traced rerun and never-armed negative control are pending.

landing-persistfmt-window.label: persistfmt aof-failure (1s, epoll)
